description: Passive joint moments, one row per joint. A measured row gives, for each direction away from neutral, the onset angle (rad) and polynomial stiffness [k0 Nm/rad, k1 Nm/rad^2, k2 Nm/rad^3] of the restoring moment M = -(k0 x + k1 x^2 + k2 x^3) sign-adjusted per side, with x the displacement beyond the onset. Gap rows list where values could come from; no value is used without a verified source.
